format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    page-layout: full
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
params:
  rows: ""
  baseline: "dev"
  root: ".."
---

```{r setup}
# the bench files expect the repository root as working directory
setwd(params$root)
for (f in setdiff(Sys.glob("bench/*.R"), c("bench/cli.R", "bench/tests.R"))) {
  source(f)
}
rows <- utils::read.csv(params$rows, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
measured <- rows[is.na(rows$skipped) & is.na(rows$error), ]
ops <- intersect(names(bench_ops()), unique(measured$op))
# one panel row per three cells
height <- function(op) 2 + 4 * ceiling(length(unique(.bench_cell_label(measured[measured$op == op, ]))) / 3)
```

Results from ``r basename(params$rows)``, compared against **`r params$baseline`**.

## Summary

```{r summary}
#| output: asis
# the text report without its title, its headings one level down
md <- bench_report(rows, params$baseline)
md <- md[!grepl("^# ", md)]
cat(sub("^(#+) ", "\\1## ", md), sep = "\n")
```

## Time per cell

Every timed call, one box per ref.
A cross marks results that kept only median, minimum and maximum.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r time}
#| output: asis
for (op in ops) {
  cat("\n### ", op, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    sprintf("```{r time-%s, fig.width = 14, fig.height = %g}", op, height(op)),
    sprintf("bench_plot_cells(measured[measured$op == '%s', ], 'time')", op),
    "```"
  ), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE))
}
```

:::

## Memory per cell

Peak memory above the level after setup, one value per round.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r memory}
#| output: asis
for (op in ops) {
  cat("\n### ", op, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    sprintf("```{r memory-%s, fig.width = 14, fig.height = %g}", op, height(op)),
    sprintf("bench_plot_cells(measured[measured$op == '%s', ], 'memory')", op),
    "```"
  ), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE))
}
```

:::

## Scaling

Median over n, both axes logarithmic, for cells measured at more than one size.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Time

```{r scaling-time, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 10}
bench_plot_scaling(measured, "time")
```

### Memory

```{r scaling-memory, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 10}
